messages:
harper-docs: Quick flag from onboarding today: the `examples/starter` README has multiple copy/paste mismatches that are tripping new users.

owen-se: Can you list them? I'll take the README PR if it's small.

harper-docs: Sure 1) curl example uses `Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY` but docker-compose and SDK examples use `REDWOOD_API_KEY`. 2) The README implies SDK retries "are automatic" but our client libraries only enable limited retries by default. 3) Go example constructor shape doesn't match current go-sdk.

nina-qa: Repro steps: clone examples, set env per README, run curl -> 401. The compose file maps `REDWOOD_API_KEY` into the container, so the README's `export REDWOOD_KEY` is wrong.

lucas-devex: Here's the problematic curl that's in the README now (bad):

```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Token $REDWOOD_KEY" \
  -d '{"model":"gpt-mini","input":"hello"}'
```

harper-docs: And the Go snippet in the same README is outdated: `client.New(ctx, apiKey)` but current is `client.NewClient(ctx, client.WithAPIKey(apiKey))`. That mismatch causes copy/paste confusion during workshops.

owen-se: I'll open a small PR to: (a) standardize env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (b) change curl header to `Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY`, (c) update the Go and JS examples to the current ctor shapes, and (d) replace the vague retry line with: "SDKs provide limited automatic retries for transient errors; configure retry/backoff explicitly in production via the SDK options."

nina-qa: Please add a tiny smoke test in CI that runs the README curl against a mocked endpoint so we catch future drift. Even a simple netcat or tiny Python HTTP server will do.

lucas-devex: Also suggest adding a single-line troubleshooting bullet under Quickstart: "If you get 401, verify your env var name and that your Authorization header is 'Bearer <KEY>' (not 'Token <KEY>')."

owen-se: Will include before/after snippets in the PR description to speed review.

pr-bot: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/examples/pull/999 1 updates README, docker-compose env, and adds smoke CI job. CI: sample-smoke-test started.

harper-docs: Thanks! After merge I'll patch the quickstart landing page and add a changelog note so support can close related tickets. This should reduce first-day friction. :raised_hands:
